name: The Harrowed Fleet
description: A coalition of Zakov pirates who turned against their own, Kahfagian privateers who outlived their letters of marque, and Sidhi refugees who will never return to Galanina. They are a fleet of the damned—outcasts, debtors, and deserters who command the shadow-lanes of the Amaranthine, the Dolmis, and the Aberderrin. They prey on slavers, tithe-collectors, and anyone who flies a Veiled or Admiralty banner. They ask no questions, and they answer no summons.
location: The Amaranthine Sea and the Dolmis coast
leverage: Privateer commissions, safe ports, smuggler routes, and the only known charts of the Ninth Wave's approach.
debtTrigger: When Obligation fills, the Fleet demands a single 'favor'—a flagship towing duty, a safe harbour for a wounded Fleet captain, or an act of sabotage against an Imperial or Veiled port. Refusal is mutiny.
quirk: Every captain in the Fleet wears a ring made of melted-down chains; the chains were from a ship they once crewed or one they once sank. The metal is always warm to the touch.
keyNPCs: Captain Verena (a Zakov pirate who has never lost a fight, and who has never been seen without a deck of cards in her hand)
The Navigator (a blind Sidhi pilot who reads the stars by their heat on his skin)
Mist-Speaker Elias (a former Kahfagian mirror-keeper who was drowned and refused to die; he still speaks to the fog)
hooks: A slaver ship from Ashaan has been spotted in the Dolmis, flying a false flag of a neutral kingdom. The Fleet wants it taken—and its cargo of children freed.
A Kahfagian commodore has offered the Fleet a 'pardon'—if they will sail against a rebel nation. They suspect it is a trap.
A captain's ring has grown cold. Its owner has died in a way that broke the Fleet's oldest custom: they died alone, without a witness.
